voc_annotator.copy_previous: Copy all boxes from the previous image (Ctrl+Shift+V)
voc_annotator.clear_boxes: Clear all boxes on this image
voc_annotator.reset_annotation: Delete this image's annotation file (back to unlabeled)
voc_annotator.class_rename: Rename class (updates every annotation in the project)
voc_annotator.class_delete: Delete class (removes its boxes from the project)
voc_annotator.no_image: Open an images folder to start labeling
voc_annotator.status_classes_added: Added {count} new classes found in the annotations to the project
voc_annotator.confirm_unsaved: This image has unsaved changes. Save them?
voc_annotator.confirm_clear: Clear all {count} boxes on this image?
voc_annotator.confirm_reset: Delete this image's annotation file and mark it unlabeled?
voc_annotator.confirm_delete_class: Delete class "{name}"? The {count} boxes using it in this project are deleted too. This cannot be undone.
voc_annotator.class_operation_failed: Class change failed (project config could not be written).
voc_annotator.no_project: No project folder; classes cannot be changed.
voc_annotator.no_previous: The previous image has no annotation.
voc_annotator.copied_previous: Copied {count} boxes from the previous image.
voc_annotator.auto_label_no_model: No ONNX model found: set one in settings, or train and export best.onnx first.
voc_annotator.auto_label_dropped: Ignored {count} boxes whose model class is not in the project (enable adding classes in settings).
voc_annotator.help_text:
A / Left  previous        D / Right  next        N  next unlabeled
W  toggle draw mode        Esc  leave draw mode / clear selection
Left drag: draws in draw mode; moves a box or pans in select mode
Drag a handle of the selected box: resize        Right click: select box and open menu
Wheel: zoom at the cursor        Middle drag or Space + left drag: pan
F  fit        Ctrl+1  actual size        + / -  zoom
1 - 9  pick class (changes the selected box)        E  difficult
Del  delete box        Ctrl+D  duplicate        Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V  copy / paste boxes
Ctrl+Shift+V  copy all boxes from the previous image        Arrows  nudge selected box (Shift = faster)
Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y  undo / redo        Ctrl+S  save        Ctrl+L  AI pre-label
H  show / hide labels        F1  this help
voc_annotator.setting_copy_previous: Copy the previous image's boxes onto an unlabeled image when opening it
voc_annotator.setting_fit_on_open: Fit each image to the window (off keeps zoom and position for frame-by-frame labeling)
voc_annotator.setting_write_yolo: Also write YOLO txt next to the annotations
voc_annotator.setting_model_hint: Empty = newest best.onnx under the project folder
voc_annotator.mode_merge: Merge (skip detections overlapping an existing box of the same class)
voc_annotator.setting_add_classes: Add new model classes to the project
voc_annotator.setting_auto_label_on_open: AI pre-label unlabeled images when opening them
